bind_address.description: Network address (host:port) on which the exporter listens for Prometheus scrapes.

ipmi_config_file.description: Path to an external YAML/JSON file containing per-host IPMI credentials and options. Leave empty to use inline credentials.

ipmi_over_lan.description: Enable IPMI over LAN (required for remote IPMI connections). Disable only for direct serial/IPMI-USB.

ipmi_user.description: Default IPMI username used for devices without per-host credentials.

ipmi_password.description: Default IPMI password used for devices without per-host credentials.

ipmi_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for each IPMI command before failing.

ipmi_retries.description: Number of times to retry a failed IPMI command before marking it as failed.

ipmi_tls_insecure.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for HTTPS IPMI connections. Enable only if using self-signed certs.

ipmi_devices.description: List of IPMI devices with host-specific credentials and options. Overrides global credentials if provided.

hostname.description: Hostname or IP address of the IPMI device.

username.description: Username to use for this specific device.

password.description: Password to use for this specific device.

privilege.description: Privilege level for the IPMI session (e.g., 'user', 'operator', 'admin').

blacklisted_sensors.description: List of sensor names or GUIDs to exclude from metric collection. Useful to silence noisy or non-critical sensors.

collect_sensor_readings.description: Collect sensor readings (temperature, fan speed, voltage, etc.).

collect_sel.description: Collect System Event Log (SEL) entries as metrics.

collect_sdr.description: Collect Sensor Data Records (metadata about sensors).

collect_fru.description: Collect Field Replaceable Unit (FRU) inventory information.

max_concurrent_requests.description: Maximum number of concurrent IPMI connection attempts. Reduce on low-memory systems.
